name: Operations overview
prompt: Operations overview scorecard: overall on-time delivery rate, average delay days, number of SKUs below reorder point, average warehouse utilization, and the monthly on-time delivery trend.

binding.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN delivered <= promised THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1), 0) AS on_time_rate
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE status = 'delivered'
  AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)

copy.title: On-time delivery rate
copy.caption: 66.5% of shipments arrived on or before the promised date.

binding.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(delay_days), 2) AS avg_delay_days
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE status = 'delivered'
  AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)

copy.title: Average delay days
copy.caption: Delivered shipments averaged 0.38 delay days, so arrivals were nearly on time.

binding.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS skus_below_reorder FROM stock_risk WHERE below_reorder = TRUE

copy.title: SKUs below reorder
copy.caption: 24 distinct SKUs were below their reorder point.

binding.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(utilization_pct), 1) AS avg_utilization_pct FROM warehouse_utilization

copy.title: Average warehouse utilization
copy.caption: Warehouses are operating at 22.6% average utilization.

binding.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', delivered) AS delivered_month, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_late = FALSE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS on_time_rate FROM shipment_performance WHERE delivered IS NOT NULL AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE) AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

copy.title: On-time delivery trend
copy.caption: On-time delivery fell from 78.4% to 57.7% over the period, with only a brief rebound in April.
